title: Irreducible integer extension by zero vanishing
statement: Let X be an irreducible Noetherian topological space and d a nonnegative integer with dim X <= d [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Assume that for every nonnegative integer e<d, every Noetherian topological space Y with dim Y <= e, every abelian sheaf G on Y, and every nonnegative integer r>e, H^r(Y,G) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero. Then for every nonnegative integer p>d and every quasi-compact open U of X, H^p(X,j_! Z_U) is zero, where Z_U is the constant integer sheaf on U and j_! is abelian open extension by zero [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero].

proof.text: If U is empty, all stalks of j_!Z_U are zero by the extension-by-zero stalk theorem, so the sheaf is zero. The additive Ext cohomology functor preserves zero objects, so the conclusion follows.

For nonempty U, apply the proper-complement dimension lemma. If the complement Z is empty, every abelian sheaf on Z has zero stalks, hence is zero and has zero cohomology in every degree. Otherwise obtain e<d with dim Z<=e and apply hlower to the inverse image G of the constant integer sheaf, in degree p-1. The integer inequality e<p-1 follows from e<d<p.

Apply the open-closed sequence to the constant integer sheaf C_X. Closed-pushforward comparison identifies the cohomology of its third term with that of G on Z. Mathlib Ext.chgUniv transports subsingletonness between the universe of this comparison and the smaller Ext universe used in the unchanged target.

Constant-sheaf acyclicity kills degree p of the middle term since p>0. Mathlib Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ says every degree-p class of the first term is the boundary of a degree-(p-1) class of the third term. The latter is zero, so every class of the first term is zero.
Transport along the comparison between the two constant-integer extension constructions to obtain the required vanishing.

theorem irreducible_integer_extension_vanishing
    (X : TopCat.{u}) [NoetherianSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace X]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hlower : ∀ (e : ℕ), e < d →
      ∀ (Y : Type u) [TopologicalSpace Y] [NoetherianSpace Y]
        (hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
        (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (r : ℕ), e < r → IsZero (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H' G r (⊤ : Opens Y)))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : d < p) (U : Opens X) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) :
    IsZero (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H'
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) p
      (⊤ : Opens X))
